scope: Authored CPU oracle; local fixed-input shape constraints, no provider-quality or installed claim

assumptions: Lexical relationships do not prove execution order, runtime values or import behavior.
Unresolved attributes, dynamic namespaces and omitted files require source inspection or new evidence.
limitations: Default-value edges apply only when the caller omits that argument; receiver-attribute edges are possible relationships.
This is not a call graph or complete control-flow analysis. Type annotations and dynamic namespace resolution are not indexed.

assumptions: Only the selected integer definition changes; supported direct lexical bindings retain their source meanings.
Branches, call order, import overrides and runtime mutation are not evaluated.
limitations: Only integer literals, direct names/imports, unary signs and +, -, *, //, % are evaluated.
No execution, tensor shape, checkpoint compatibility or candidate-validity claim is made.
